q: Enschedese Boys were meant to move into the new Diekman stadium in the 1950s, but another club got it. Which?
note: nl.wikipedia Enschedese Boys: planned move to Het Diekman, but Sportclub Enschede became tenant.

q: FC Den Bosch took over BVV's professional licence in 1965. Which other Den Bosch club joined, giving the name FC Den Bosch '67?
note: nl.wikipedia FC Den Bosch: foundation took BVV licence in 1965, Wilhelmina joined a year later, FC Den Bosch 67.

q: In which year did Vitesse first reach the Eredivisie?
sub: They filled the place freed by the ADO and Holland Sport merger, then lost 12-1 to Ajax and went down.
note: nl.wikipedia SBV Vitesse: first Eredivisie in 1971, taking the place freed by the ADO and Holland Sport merger after finishing third; 12-1 loss to Ajax. Reworded from "win promotion".

q: Which club, relegated to the Tweede Divisie in 1969, reached the Eredivisie through the 1975 nacompetitie?
note: nl.wikipedia FC Eindhoven: EVV relegated to Tweede Divisie 1969, promoted via nacompetitie 1975.

q: RKC joined the professional ranks in 1984. Their first professional match was a draw against which Tilburg club?
note: nl.wikipedia RKC Waalwijk: first pro match a home draw vs Willem II.

q: Which coach led RKC from the amateurs into professional football in 1984?
note: nl.wikipedia RKC Waalwijk: trainer Leen Looijen when RKC joined pro football in 1984-85.

q: Fortuna Sittard returned to the Eredivisie in 1982 after 13 years. Which club did they beat 3-1 to make sure of it?
note: nl.wikipedia Fortuna Sittard: 1982 return after 13 years sealed by 3-1 win over SC Heracles.

q: Which Hague club averaged more than 13,000 at home while winning promotion from the Eerste Divisie B in 1957-58?
sub: Around 200,000 came to their 15 home games.
note: nl.wikipedia Holland Sport: Eerste Divisie B champions 1958, 200,000 at 15 home games.

q: Telstar dropped into the Eerste Divisie in 1978 despite having which future Barcelona and Netherlands coach in the squad?
note: nl.wikipedia Telstar: relegated 1977-78 despite Louis van Gaal in the squad.

q: Heracles split its professional side from the amateurs in 1974. What was the new professional club called?
sub: It was later renamed Heracles Almelo.
note: nl.wikipedia Heracles Almelo: stichting SC Heracles 74 founded 1 July 1974. Rename year conflicts within page (1998 vs 1999), sub made year-free.

q: In 1979 FC Dordrecht changed its name to sound more regional. What did it become?
note: nl.wikipedia FC Dordrecht: renamed DS 79 on 1 July 1979 for more regional appeal.

q: Roda JC was formed in 1962. Why did the new club start in the Eerste Divisie rather than the Eredivisie?
a: Rapid JC had just been relegated, and Roda Sport were in the Tweede Divisie
note: nl.wikipedia Roda Sport: Roda Sport in Tweede Divisie, Rapid JC relegated 1962, new Roda JC started in Eerste Divisie.

q: From 1981-82, which Eerste Divisie finishing place joined the champions in going up automatically?
sub: Three Eredivisie clubs went down directly from then on.
note: nl.wikipedia Nacompetitie: from 1981-82 number 2 promoted directly, three Eredivisie clubs down.

q: From 1989-90 the loser of the nacompetitie final got a second chance. Against which Eredivisie team?
note: nl.wikipedia Nacompetitie: from 1989-90 final loser played the number 16 of the Eredivisie.

q: Jan Jongbloed played in the Eerste Divisie in 1962-63 for which Amsterdam club, a year before it won the title?
note: nl.wikipedia Jan Jongbloed: DWS 1959-1972. Delpher Het Vrije Volk 17 June 1963: Jongbloed in goal for DWS vs Roda JC in Eerste Divisie. DWS champions 1963-64.

q: FC Eindhoven's professional side split from the amateurs in 1997. What was it called until 2002?
note: nl.wikipedia FC Eindhoven: SBV Eindhoven 1997-2002.

q: De Volewijckers, national champions in 1944 and later an Eerste Divisie side, came from the north of which city?
note: nl.wikipedia De Volewijckers: Amsterdam-Noord, national champions 1944.

q: DFC, Dordrecht's professional club until 1972, was founded in 1883 as a club for which sport?
a: Cricket, it began as the Dordrechtsche Cricket Club
note: nl.wikipedia FC Dordrecht: founded 1883 as Dordrechtsche Cricket Club.

q: In 1972 the professional side of which Dordrecht club was renamed FC Dordrecht?
note: nl.wikipedia FC Dordrecht: pro side of DFC renamed FC Dordrecht in 1972.

q: On the way to the 1958 KNVB Cup final, Eerste Divisie side Volendam won 3-1 away in the semi-final. Against which Eredivisie club?
note: nl.wikipedia FC Volendam: semi-final MVV 1-3 Volendam in 1957-58 cup.

q: Johan Neeskens began his career at RCH, then an Eerste Divisie club. What do the letters stand for?
note: nl.wikipedia Johan Neeskens: Racing Club Heemstede.

q: Which Arnhem club, then in the Eerste Divisie, was rescued financially by its city council in 1985, four years before going up?
note: nl.wikipedia SBV Vitesse: rescued with council money in 1985, Eerste Divisie champions 1989.
